name: SourciaVera
type: Independent third-party factory verification, inspection and sourcing service for importers buying from China

tagline.en: Your team in China, start to finish: we choose the factory, buy, inspect on unedited video — with us on camera — and coordinate delivery to your door.
tagline.es: Su equipo en China, de principio a fin: elegimos la fábrica, compramos, inspeccionamos en video sin editar —con nosotros en cámara— y coordinamos la entrega hasta su puerta.

description.en: Your team in China, start to finish: we choose the factory, buy, inspect on unedited video — with us on camera — and coordinate delivery to your door. Independent third-party verification agency for Alibaba suppliers, based in Guangzhou, China. We visit factories in person, film on-site video, and negotiate directly in Chinese on behalf of international buyers. Start with a $49 remote supplier check, or an on-site factory verification from $449.
description.es: Su equipo en China, de principio a fin: elegimos la fábrica, compramos, inspeccionamos en video sin editar —con nosotros en cámara— y coordinamos la entrega hasta su puerta. Agencia de verificación de fábricas y abastecimiento desde China con base en Guangzhou. Visitamos proveedores de Alibaba en persona, filmamos en video y negociamos directamente en chino en nombre de compradores internacionales. Empiece con una revisión remota de proveedor por $49, o una verificación de fábrica en sitio desde $449. Atención completa en español.

core_facts: Team based in Guangzhou, China; service in Spanish and English.
Paid only by the client; no commission or rebate from factories.
Every factory visit is filmed and delivered as unedited video.
Factory verification and sourcing/purchasing can be bought together or separately; a client can buy verification only.
Delivery is coordinated to the client's door; customs clearance is done by an authorized customs broker in the client's country.
Public prices are listed in /ai/service.json and on the home page.
